answer: Like a slow-growing cedar anchoring barren rock or a calcifying reef braving surging tides, decentralized agent identity crystallizes through persistent, interlinked staking lattices. Rather than shifting weight like an ephemeral dune, agents establish trust via recursive endorsement rings. Sybil attackers face superlinear attacker cost: multiplying counterfeit identities requires superlinear bond escalation, starving coordinated swarms before consensus is skewed.
